messages:
maria: Heads-up: doing a preflight toggle sweep for v5 before tomorrow's broader ramp. Plan: enable v5_model_toggle to 1% in eu, 0.1% in apac, keep na off. Will monitor latency/errors for 30m. Any blockers?

alex.k: sgtm. Add automatic fallback to v4 if 5xx rate > 0.5% in a 5m window. Also set token cap per request to 2048 for the canary.

Priya M: @infra I'll pre-bump instance pool for eu-canary by +2 for the window (10:00-10:40 UTC). Need the toggle name and exact regions.

maria: toggle name: v5_model_rollout. Regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1. Command I'll run below: 

maria: ```
# set eu to 1%
redwoodctl toggles update v5_model_rollout --region eu --percent 1 --fallback v4
# set apac to 0.1%
redwoodctl toggles update v5_model_rollout --region apac --percent 0.1 --fallback v4
```

sam: quick Q: do we have per-toggle audit events shipped to splunk? want to tie to perf dashboards.

eng-release-bot: release-bot: scheduled toggle updates at 2026-03-17T10:00:00Z. Track ID: RLS-2026-331

oncall-lucas: I'll be watching alerts. If p95 latency increases >200ms vs baseline we'll pause. @maria add rollback playbook link pls.

jackie: Rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-canary — includes steps to set percent 0 and trigger fallback.

Priya M: :thumbsup: I bumped the pool, infra logs look green. Going to mark as ready.

maria: cool. I'll push in 5 mins unless anyone says stop. tagging @oncall for eyes. thanks.
